field_overlay_enable.label: Enable
field_overlay_enable.description: If enabled, user can set an overlay over the Image

field_overlay_color.label: Color on Default
field_overlay_color.description: Set an overlay color, it will be visible over the Image

field_overlay_opacity.label: Opacity
field_overlay_opacity.description: Set an overlay color opacity, it will be visible over the Image

field_hover_overlay_enable.label: Enable Overlay
field_hover_overlay_enable.description: If enabled, an overlay color will be displayed over the image when the mouse hovers.

field_hover_overlay_color.label: Color
field_hover_overlay_color.description: Set a color. This color will be visible when the mouse hovers over the image.

field_hover_overlay_opacity.label: Opacity
field_hover_overlay_opacity.description: Define how transparent or opaque hover overlay color should be.

field_hover_overlay_arrive_from.label: Styles
field_hover_overlay_arrive_from.description: You can control the overlay style when the mouse hovers.

field_hover_overlay_content_arrive_from.label: Text Content Reveal
field_hover_overlay_content_arrive_from.description: You can control the Content when the mouse hovers.

field_hover_overlay_transition_delay.label: Animation Delay
field_hover_overlay_transition_delay.description: If you would like to add a delay before your animation runs you can designate that delay here in seconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

field_hover_overlay_transition_time.label: Animation Time
field_hover_overlay_transition_time.description: You can control the arrival animation time of the hover overlay

field_hover_overlay_content_enable.label: Content
field_hover_overlay_content_enable.description: If enabled, you can set content on the hover overlay, it will be displayed with hover overlay when the mouse hovers.

field_hover_overlay_content_placement.label: Content Placement
field_hover_overlay_content_placement.description: You can control the placement of the hover overlay content

field_hover_overlay_content_alignment.label: Content Alignment
field_hover_overlay_content_alignment.description: You can control the hover overlay content alignment

item.label: Padding around content
item.description: You can set the padding around the hover overlay content

field_caption_enable.label: Enable
field_caption_enable.description: If enabled, user can set a caption for the image

field_caption_placement.label: Placement
field_caption_placement.description: You can control the placement of the caption

field_caption_background.label: Background Color
field_caption_background.description: Set background for the caption section

field_reveal_directions.label: Direction
field_reveal_directions.description: You can control the direction of Reveal Animation

field_reveal_delay.label: Delay (Sec)
field_reveal_delay.description: You can control the delay of the Reveal Image Animation

field_reveal_animation_time.label: Animation Time (Sec)
field_reveal_animation_time.description: You can control the time of Animation to Reveal the Image

field_reveal_view_port.label: Animate in Viewport (%)
field_reveal_view_port.description: You can set the position of the Viewport(Display position) when Image will Reveal

field_hover_image_effect_enable.label: Enable Image Effect
field_hover_image_effect_enable.description: If enabled, you can set few effects on image,this effect will be display when mouse hover

field_effect_style.label: Effects
field_effect_style.description: Choose an effect, its action will be visible when mouse hovers

field_reveal_effect_delay.label: Effect Delay (Sec)
field_reveal_effect_delay.description: If you would like to add a delay before your animation runs you can designate that delay here in seconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

field_reveal_effect_animation_time.label: Effect Time (Sec)
field_reveal_effect_animation_time.description: If you would like to add a time of your animation runs you can designate that time here in seconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

src.label: Image
src.description: Upload your desired image, or type in the URL to the image you would like to display.

alt.label: Alternative Text
alt.description: This defines the HTML ALT text. A short description of your image can be placed here.

titleText.label: Title Text
titleText.description: This defines the HTML Title text.

field_lightbox_enable.label: Open in Lightbox
field_lightbox_enable.description: Here you can choose whether or not the image should open in Lightbox. Note: if you select to open the image in Lightbox, url options below will be ignored.

field_link_url.label: Image Link URL
field_link_url.description: If you would like your image to be a link, input your destination URL here. No link will be created if this field is left blank.

field_link_target.label: Image Link Target
field_link_target.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window

field_zoom_scale.label: Zooming Range
field_zoom_scale.description: You can control the transition time of the Effects

field_zooming_time.label: Animation Duration (Sec)
field_zooming_time.description: You can control the Animation time of the Effect

field_zooming_blur_out_time.label: Blur Out Animation Duration (Sec)
field_zooming_blur_out_time.description: You can control the Animation Blur Out time of the Effect

field_zoom_rotate.label: Rotate Range (Degree)
field_zoom_rotate.description: Here you can adjust the rotation of your image.

field_grayscale.label: Gray Scale Level (%)
field_grayscale.description: You can control the Gray Scale of the Effect

field_Speed_curve.label: Animation Speed Curve
field_Speed_curve.description: Here you can adjust the easing method of your animation. Easing your animation in and out will create a smoother effect when compared to a linear speed curve.

align.label: Image Alignment
align.description: Here you can choose the image alignment.
